title: sorbus carpinifolia
intro: Sorbus carpinifolia, commonly known as Mountain Ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, fever, and digestive problems due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus carpinifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Sorbus carpinifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used to treat various health conditions.
